issues.after: Er verspricht deshalb nicht, wieder zum Kurs zu kommen.
issues.source_issue: The Chinese says he does not therefore promise to return, not that he promises not to return. The current unseparated nicht zurueckzukehren can negate the return itself. Put nicht explicitly on verspricht and separate the infinitive object.

issues.after: Der andere erklärt das Aufhören nicht zum Beweis von Unabhängigkeit.
issues.source_issue: The other person is the friend who continues attending. The Chinese does not say quitting proves his own independence: it denies making quitting a general certificate of independence. Remove possessive seiner without assigning motives or requiring the friend to quit.
